note: This is the committed expected-set for GitHub branch-protection required-status-checks across the clientA fleet (A5 of the remediation plan). It is the ratchet's reference point: checks are only ever ADDED to a repo's requiredChecks[] here, in lockstep with a `gh api` PUT that actually flips the check to required on GitHub (enforcement-ladder rung 6 -- see clientA/ENFORCEMENT-LADDER.md) -- never removed as a forward action. bin/verify-branch-protection.mjs asserts live required-status-checks are a superset of this manifest's expected set for every repo entry below; if a check is ever silently un-required in GitHub's UI/API while it is still listed here, the probe fails loudly (exit 3) rather than staying green. Rolling back a flip means removing that ONE check from both GitHub and this manifest together, in the same change -- gates never weaken silently, and this manifest never drifts ahead of or behind live reality without the probe noticing. `requireSigned` (added 2026-09-15, default false) is the signing expectation bin/commit-provenance.mjs reads: only an entry carrying requireSigned:true makes its unsigned-on-protected-branch rule applicable, and a repo absent from this list is not-applicable for that rule rather than clean or dirty.
